senses.en_definition: One person; a or an, used when identifying a person or their role.

messages.en: I'm waiting at the shop by myself. Are you here yet?
Yeah, I'm looking for parking. Take a seat first. I'll be in shortly.

senses.en_definition: Along the entire length or extent of something.
Throughout a whole period of time.
As far as one's knowledge or memory extends.

collocations.en: as far as I can remember

messages.en: Are you home this afternoon? I want to bring back that food container.
Yes, I'm home all day today. Pop round whenever you're free. Text me first, though, in case I don't hear the doorbell.

senses.en_definition: Half; one of two equal parts of a whole.

messages.en: Sis, is there any cake left in the fridge?
Yep. I've eaten half and saved the other half for you.
Okay, don't go finishing it all! I'll be home in a bit!

senses.en_definition: Should; ought to, as a matter of duty or proper conduct.
Should; be expected to, according to an arrangement or reasonable expectation.
Properly; with appropriate care and attention.

collocations.en: be treated as one should be

messages.en: Where's Amir? He should be here by now, right? He said earlier he'd be here at eight.
Hang on, I'll text him. Maybe he's having trouble finding parking.
Yeah, ask him what he wants to eat while you're at it. Let's go ahead and order.
